Name: Placeable Minecarts
Author: thesandmansleeps
Description:
[size=4][b][u]PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE THING

[/u][/b]This mod does 2 things: Adds  minecart furniture items that can bring up the minecart menu, lets YOU add locations to the minecart menu.
This mod DOES NOT unlock the minecarts for you.

Sometimes you need more minecarts but no one has modded them to exactly where you want or you new favorite mod map doesn't have any. Now you can do it yourself![/size]

This mod can be dangerous if used recklessly (you could get stuck and have to restart the day or stay there until you pass out)!
Making the furniture item act as a one-way minecart is easy. Unfortunately there's no simple way to attach a return point to furniture items. The solution i came up with was to let YOU choose the location you warp to when you choose your custom minecart location from the menu.
I recommend using Generic Mod Configuration Menu to edit the config.

[size=4][center]~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~[/center][/size][size=4]
[center][b]DIRECTIONS[/b]﻿[/center]
1. (Assuming you have unlocked minecarts) Buy a placeable cart from Clint and put it where you want. If you only want it to be one-way you're done![/size]

[size=4]2. Open the config and enable Cart 1 (it is now in the minecart menu and will teleport you to map: Farm x: 10 y: 10)[/size]

[size=4]3. Set the Location1 field to the map you placed the cart in ie: FarmHouse if you put it in your house.[/size]

[size=4]4. Set the Target1 X and Target1 Y fields to the coordinates that will warp you next to the cart you placed (x=left to right, y=top to bottom, coordinates x = 0, y = 0 is top left corner of map)[/size]

[size=4]5. Test it out! Right-click your placed minecart and the minecart menu should open. You should see "Cart1" as a location, lets warp to the bus stop then warp to Cart1. You should now have warped to the map and xy coordinates you set. CONGRATULATIONS![/size]

[size=4]6. OPTIONALLY change the Cart 1 Name field to change the name in the minecart menu so you will know where you're going![/size]

[size=4]7. Enable Cart 2, 3, 4, and even 5!!!! for up to 5 custom minecart locations! set them the exact same way.[/size]
[center][size=4]~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~[/size][/center]
[size=3]Now you may have realized that the cart item and warp menu are completely separate. You can disable the cart item if you don't want to use it and you'll still be able to set custom locations in the minecart menu to say.. your silo!? (or a one-way cart some other modder put in) but how will you open the menu from there? use the cart alternative barely noticeable placeable item to open the menu!

Q: HOW CAN I GET MY MAP LOCATION AND COORDINATES!?
﻿A: you could try trial and error by just guessing and seeing what happens**. You could use all sorts of mods that show your location like  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]. You can also use SMAPI console commands and type into smapi "debug worldmapposition" (without the quotation marks) and the first line will show your map and coordinates (see picture). You can also get location names [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Location_data#Location_names]Here[/url].
** if you're going the trial and error route, do it first thing in the morning in case you get stuck and need to reload the day
